temper.title: Служба национальных парков США · Керамика Форт-Эйншент
temper.passage: Fort Ancient pottery used added crushed shell as temper; earlier Woodland pottery often used crushed stone. The archaeological study explains traits and continuing use of grit.

slip.title: Служба национальных парков США · Ангобная керамика Форт-Ванкувера
slip.passage: The artifact article describes slip as a decorative clay coating, colored bands and encrusted decoration made by rolling a vessel in dry clay crumbs while the slip is wet.

north.title: Метрополитен-музей · Исследование сосуда эпохи Северной Ци
north.passage: Appendix definitions include slip (clay and water), glaze (glassy coating with silica and fluxes), and appliqué relief formed in a mold. It describes how iron, often titanium, and firing atmosphere contribute to celadon color.

nish.title: Метрополитен-музей · Исследование керамики сграффито из Нишапура
nish.passage: Microscopy distinguishes earthenware body, white slip and separate outer glaze in sgraffito ceramics. The bowl incorporates incised design, polychrome splashes and a transparent glaze.

timu.title: Служба национальных парков США · Керамика тимукуа
timu.passage: Pointed tools cut linear designs on damp surfaces. A grid-cut paddle pressed into clay creates check-stamped designs.

paracas.title: Метрополитен-музей · Сероглиняная чаша культуры Паракас
paracas.passage: The object is a greyware bowl with incised designs from the Paracas culture; archaeological record gives a Peruvian context.

inhum.title: Институт археологии РАН · Некрополь скалвов
inhum.passage: Excavation report explicitly pairs ингумация with трупоположение. Some burials at the necropolis retain stone constructions; some individuals were buried with a horse or a horse head.

bird.title: Historic England · Раскопки римского могильника в Бёрдосволде
bird.passage: Cremation burials include urns containing burned human bone and charcoal. X-rays show small metal finds near the bottom of some urns; one deposit used a nailed wooden box.

secondary.title: Antiquity · Исследования погребений Долины кувшинов в Лаосе
secondary.passage: Paper treats the disarticulated assemblage in Jar 1 as a potential collection of secondary burials and discusses competing formation explanations. It describes deliberate secondary deposition as a distinct possibility.

relic.title: European Journal of Archaeology · Перемещение человеческих костей в бронзовом веке
relic.passage: Study analyzes disarticulated and redeposited human bone, including bones deliberately stacked by an inhumation and possible extraction/redeposition of older skeletal material.

gnezd.title: Институт археологии РАН · Курганы Гнёздовского комплекса
gnezd.passage: Excavations verified no later disturbance or actual burial in mound L-205. It was interpreted tentatively as a commemorative cenotaph. A separate mound, L-206, had a wooden burial chamber.

obs.title: PLOS ONE · Источники обсидиана в доколониальной Новой Зеландии
obs.passage: X-ray fluorescence compared trace element distributions in archaeological volcanic glass and reference sources. The paper examines multiple site types and discusses distribution and transport as inferences.

shell.title: PLOS ONE · Распределение раковинных куч на островах Фарасан
shell.passage: Elevation map plots surveyed shell midden sites. The study examines uneven visibility and the impact of past sea-level change on distribution and preservation.

dry.title: Смитсоновский институт · Египетские мумии
dry.passage: Natural drying by desert sand and air could preserve bodies, and Egyptians later developed deliberate mummification.

zoo.title: Oxford Archaeology · Отчёт о раскопках в Уикфорде
zoo.passage: Table 10 records NISP and MNI plus each as a percentage by taxon; nearby tables record element and weight in grams.

nps.title: Служба национальных парков США · Полевой глоссарий форта Пуласки
nps.passage: Defines archaeological feature with examples, including trash pits, foundations, postholes and hearths. A hearth is a fire spot for cooking and heating.

context.title: Служба национальных парков США · Археологический контекст
context.passage: Provenience and associations help relate an object to its stratigraphic location, other artifacts and ecofacts. Different site formation processes can change the original context.

tempGloss.title: Служба национальных парков США · Археологический глоссарий
tempGloss.passage: Temper entry includes sand, shell and mica among additions to clay.

posture.title: Музей-заповедник «Кижи» · Археологические раскопки в музее
posture.passage: Describes recording body position and orientation and how they help understand burial rites.

knossos.title: Annual of the British School at Athens · Гробницы у дворца в Кноссе
knossos.passage: Compares primary and secondary deposits at Knossos to mainland Greek cases where older bones were pushed aside to make room for new burials.

robbed.title: Институт Гриффита · Записки об ограблении гробницы
robbed.passage: Excavation report investigates material signs of robbery and displacement in Tutankhamun's tomb.

intrusive.title: Институт археологии РАН · Археологические материалы о погребениях
intrusive.passage: Describes archaeological cases of intrusive later burials in existing mounds.

lith.title: Висконсинский университет в Ла-Кроссе · Анализ каменных находок
lith.passage: Shows core, waste flakes, hammerstone, bifaces, points, end scraper, drill and utilized flake as distinct archaeological material. Sorting lithic objects helps interpret activity and technology.

tool.title: Смитсоновский институт · Орудия среднего каменного века
tool.passage: Stone scrapers prepared hide, wood and other materials. Stone awls were used to perforate hides. Hafted points formed spears.

dates.title: Historic England · Радиоуглеродное датирование
dates.passage: The reporting guidance illustrates that a desired probability can be represented by several separate calendar ranges. The calibration curve combines measurements on samples of known age.

ochre.title: Институт археологии · Материалы раскопок погребений с охрой
ochre.passage: Excavation report records ochre by the skeleton and underneath a vessel in a grave.

doubleBurial.title: Historic England · Англосаксонский могильник Фликстон II
doubleBurial.passage: The site description discusses double graves that include a child and the limits of inferring family relationships.

fired.title: Historic England · Научные методы датирования памятников палеолита
fired.passage: Luminescence dating section: luminescence can date the last heating of stones and flints.

note: CURRENT uses actual artifacts and field cases. Unsupported waterproofness and generic anatomic-position claims remain historical. 069–070 await the reciprocal note fixes in 086–087.
